description: Which monitoring a project is connected to — its Grafana's address, the Prometheus data source queries go to, whose token it is (a Grafana service account with the Viewer role) and whether it is switched on; 'secretSet' says a token is held, the token itself never comes back. 'connected' false means none: whoever administers the project connects it on the board's Monitoring sheet at 'url' — the token is entered there, never in this chat. 'questions' lists the ready-made questions (monitoring_hosts) with the PromQL each runs, and 'tools' what can be read. Any member of the project may ask.
name: get_monitoring
title: Get monitoring
